quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #7
										  					
  

35 Questions • Passing Score 28

questions.question: When passing a vehicle on the left, when is it safe to move back into the right lane?

options.text: When you can no longer see the vehicle over your right shoulder.
When you can see the front of the vehicle in your rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you can see the front of the vehicle in your rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: You can move back into the right lane when you see the front of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror. Always signal before changing lanes.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns you of a pedestrian crosswalk. When you see it, stay alert and let pedestrians cross safely.

questions.question: You are in a minor collision with no injuries and little damage. What should you do?

options.text: Leave your vehicle in the traffic lane until police arrive.
Move your vehicle out of the traffic lane, if possible.
Do not move your vehicle for any reason.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move your vehicle out of the traffic lane, if possible.
questions.explanation: After a collision with no injuries, move your vehicle out of the traffic lane if you can do so safely.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a flashing red traffic light?

options.text: You are traveling in the wrong direction.
Treat the intersection as if it has a stop sign.
Wait until it changes to green before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat the intersection as if it has a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. Come to a complete stop, then yield to all other traffic and pedestrians before proceeding.

questions.question: When turning left at an intersection, what must you do?

options.text: Always yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.
Oncoming traffic and pedestrians must yield to you.
Never yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.
questions.explanation: When turning left, you must yield to all oncoming traffic going straight and to all pedestrians.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that you are leaving a divided highway and entering a road with traffic going both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a yield sign is coming. Slow down when you see this warning sign.

questions.question: Drivers turning left must yield to whom?
questions.explanation: Left-turning drivers must yield to vehicles driving straight ahead. You can only turn when it is safe and you do not affect oncoming traffic.

questions.question: Which of these is illegal?

options.text: Pass another vehicle in a marked no passing zone.
Pass another vehicle over a railroad crossing.

questions.explanation: It is illegal to pass in no passing zones, at railroad crossings, at street crossings, or anywhere you cannot see far enough ahead. Never pass when the vehicle in front is stopped for a pedestrian or in work zones where passing is unsafe.

questions.question: What should you do when driving at night?

options.text: Look directly at the headlights of oncoming vehicles.

questions.explanation: Night driving is more dangerous because you cannot see as well. Increase the distance between your vehicle and the one in front to prevent collisions. Use your headlights properly and avoid looking at oncoming headlights.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you about the road ahead?

options.text: It turns sharply right, then left.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will curve to the right, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn left only after you stop.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road may be slippery when wet. Drive with caution on wet roads.

questions.question: When passing another vehicle, when should you move back into the right lane?

options.text: When you are one vehicle length ahead of the vehicle you passed.
When you can see both headlights of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror.
When you are 50 feet ahead of the vehicle you passed.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you can see both headlights of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: When you can see both headlights of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror, there is enough space between you and that vehicle. It is then safe to return to the right lane.

questions.question: Can your driving privileges be revoked if you give false information to the Secretary of State?
questions.explanation: If you sign a driver license or ID card application with false information, you may be arrested, imprisoned for up to five years, or have your driving privileges suspended or revoked for 12 months.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A downgrade or steep hill is coming.
The road ahead will become narrower.

questions.correctAnswerText: A downgrade or steep hill is coming.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a steep downgrade or hill ahead. The hill may be very long or steep, or it may have sharp curves.

questions.question: When a school bus ahead on your side of the road has its red lights flashing, you must:

options.text: Slow down to no faster than 10 mph.
Stop until the lights stop flashing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop until the lights stop flashing.
questions.explanation: When a school bus has red flashing lights and a stop arm, you must stop. Do not move until the lights stop flashing and the stop arm is pulled back. Never pass a school bus that is picking up or dropping off students.

questions.question: When should you use your horn?

options.text: When another vehicle is in your way.
When it may help prevent a crash.
When another driver makes a mistake.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it may help prevent a crash.
questions.explanation: Only use your horn when it is needed to avoid a crash. Do not use your horn just because another driver is moving slowly or is in your way.

questions.question: Must you obey instructions from school crossing guards?

options.text: Not if you do not see any children.

questions.explanation: You must always obey school crossing guards. Watch for them near schools and follow their directions.

questions.question: When driving in fog, use:
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog, rain, or snow. High beams reflect off these conditions and make it harder to see.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Be ready for traffic to merge into your lane from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready for traffic to merge into your lane from the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns that traffic will merge from the right. Be ready to let them in safely.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: If a child is riding a bicycle near your vehicle:

options.text: Expect the child to have full control of the bicycle.

questions.explanation: Children on bicycles often make sudden, unpredictable moves. They are also small and easy to miss. Stay alert around child cyclists.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should:

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that traffic will merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: When you have a green light and pedestrians are in the intersection:

options.text: You must let pedestrians cross first.
You have the right-of-way over pedestrians.
Pedestrians must wait for you to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must let pedestrians cross first.
questions.explanation: Even with a green light, you must yield to pedestrians already in the intersection. When turning on a green light, always yield to pedestrians.

questions.question: If heavy smoke covers the road ahead, you should:

options.text: Turn on four-way flashers and keep going.
Slow down, move right, and pull off the road to stop.
Turn on high beams and keep going.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, move right, and pull off the road to stop.
questions.explanation: If you see heavy smoke ahead, slow down immediately. Move as far right as possible and stop off the road. Check if it is safe before continuing. Some smoke can hurt your eyes, lungs, or be deadly.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road curves left then right.
The road curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns that the road will curve right, then curve left. Slow down to drive safely through the curves.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mean you are near a school or school crossing. Be alert and ready to stop when you see these signs.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road has many curves ahead.

questions.question: A driver whose license has been revoked for a DUI must get an alcohol and drug evaluation and pay a reinstatement fee to get their license back. Is this true?
questions.explanation: If you are convicted of a DUI, you must get an alcohol and drug evaluation. You must also complete a rehabilitation or education program, have a hearing with the Secretary of State, pay a reinstatement fee, and meet other requirements.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to situations they may not see right away. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers to watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: A bad suspension can cause:
questions.explanation: Your suspension helps you control your vehicle and makes rides smooth over different road surfaces. If your car bounces a lot after hitting a bump or is hard to control, you may need new suspension parts.

questions.question: Vehicles stopped behind a school bus with red lights flashing must stay stopped until:

options.text: All students are off the bus.
The stop arm is retracted and the bus starts moving.

questions.correctAnswerText: The stop arm is retracted and the bus starts moving.
questions.explanation: When a school bus has red lights flashing and the stop arm is out, you must stop. Stay stopped until the lights turn off, the stop arm goes in, and the bus moves again.

questions.question: Driving slower than other traffic is:

options.text: A good idea if the weather is bad.
Okay if you don't know the speed limit.
Often dangerous because other drivers may get frustrated and try to pass you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Often dangerous because other drivers may get frustrated and try to pass you.
questions.explanation: Driving slower than other traffic is dangerous. Drivers behind you may become impatient and take risky chances to pass you.
